items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Hank Jones was on piano, Seldon Powell on tenor, I played alto and clarinet. Richard Jones played trumpet. Nice little band, yeah.
